data.name: The Raincoat Man: Chaput’s Cradle
data.detailed_description:
THE CHAPUT'S CHURCH

The Raincoat Man: Chaput’s Cradle is a first-person psychological horror game set in a remote countryside house, where you are hired to babysit under strange and unsettling circumstances. What begins as a quiet night quickly turns into a disturbing experience, as the environment feels wrong, the baby behaves unnaturally, and a silent presence seems to watch from reflections and shadows.

As Samantha, you must explore the house and its surroundings, piece together fragmented information, and survive a night filled with tension, paranoia, and fear. The game focuses on atmosphere and slow-burn horror rather than combat, encouraging players to observe, hide, and make sense of unsettling events through environmental storytelling.

The world is small but interconnected, gradually opening up as the story unfolds. Each new area deepens the sense of dread, revealing subtle contradictions and disturbing details that challenge what you believe is happening. Mirrors, sounds, and unexpected encounters play a key role in building tension, while a mysterious figure known as the Raincoat Man looms over the experience.

Inspired by classic psychological horror and PSX-era aesthetics, The Raincoat Man: Chaput’s Cradle delivers an intimate and unsettling journey where fear is created through suggestion, silence, and uncertainty rather than constant confrontation.

Key Features

  • Psychological Horror Experience
    A slow-paced, tension-driven horror game focused on atmosphere, paranoia, and emotional discomfort.

  • First-Person Gameplay
    Explore environments from a first-person perspective, enhancing vulnerability and spatial awareness.

  • Stealth-Oriented Survival
    No direct combat — survive by hiding, avoiding threats, and carefully navigating dangerous situations.

  • Environmental Storytelling
    Discover the narrative through exploration, subtle visual clues, and fragmented information rather than exposition.

  • Small Open Map
    A compact but interconnected world that gradually expands, including the house and its surrounding areas.

  • Low-Poly / PSX-Inspired Visual Style
    Retro-inspired visuals designed to amplify unease and nostalgia-driven horror.

  • Single Narrative Experience
    A focused story with a single ending, crafted to leave lasting questions and interpretation.

data.short_description: Hired to babysit in a strange house, you soon realize nothing is normal. The baby is a doll, the silence feels heavy, and mirrors reveal a figure that doesn’t belong. A psychological horror experience focused on tension, puzzles, and atmosphere.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel CPU Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 460
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel CPU Core i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GPU GeForce GTX 660
